title: Mimaropa police arrest 8 for illegal LPG sale in Romblon

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police in Mimaropa arrested eight individuals and recovered dozens of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) cylinders in coordinated entrapment operations targeting alleged unauthorized trading, distribution, and counterfeiting of Petron-branded LPG products across Romblon province on Sept. 12.
